summary: Nothing blocks the merge. One advisory finding stands and one was put to a vote and refuted.

findings.description: Claimed that the redaction pass allocates a new buffer per line and doubles the cost of a noisy build.
findings.recommendation: None: the allocation is the scanner's own, which the loop already reused.

findings.description: The pattern table is documented in the config example but not in SPEC §12, which is where an operator looks first.
